newsitem.title: UK: SIG faces 1997 with confidence, pursues buys.
newsitem.headline: SIG faces 1997 with confidence, pursues buys.

text.p: British insulation and related products group Sheffield Insulations Group Plc (SIG) said on Thursday it was looking to 1997 with continued confidence and was "actively pursuing" a number of acquisition possibilities.

In March, the group said it was looking to plough back the proceeds from the disposal of its SIGAP hardware and security division into acquisitions. It sold SIGAP for 65 million stg in a management buy-out.
The group expects continued improvement in its main UK and French markets, and stable demand in Germany for those sectors in which its businesses are mainly centred.

"These factors, combined with increases in insulation standards introduced in the UK and Germany in 1995, and our strong market positions give us continued confidence for 1997," chief executive Bill Forrester told the annual meeting.
